segments.text: perdreی سمہ رادی آنو پای کرم آساادیت مو ہو جی
ان مجھت شٹ دو دیات مxtھاکت بل آساادےน پر کرشا
اتمی کرت پر امرطف رد آتماک شامب و پذویا گی
تدیو ام سو
ان موجت کام آساادیت مو ہو جی
ان مجت شٹ دو دیات مxtھاکت بل آساادےن پر کرشا
When by adopting the means of Anupaya, yogis breathing movement is over, because of the entry in Sushamna, the Central Path, and conquers the world of illusion.
Moha Jai, unma Jat Shuddhi Dhyatma Kishakta Bal Aasadhena Prakarshaat, he attends the Power of Shaktopaya.
Atmikrta Param Rata Shambha vaupadao yogi, and when he owns the Supreme Nectar of Shambha Vastit, then what happens to him?
Samatra Nirmanam Aapadhena, he feels that this whole universe is the part and parcel of his own universal being.
Samatra, Nirmanam Aapadhena, so he can create anything whatever he desires.
He observes that this objective world is the offshoot of his subjective consciousness.
Now, commentary.
He explains that Samatra means the offshoot of one's own consciousness.
When one's own consciousness is coagulated in formation of time, space, and form, that is Amshya.
So, he can create this whole universe according to his choice, whatever he thinks, whatever he desires.
Nirmanam Aapadhena Darshi, he does it because he creates it.
Yaduktam Tri Swachhande, this is said also in Swachhanda Tantra.
By taking the deception of grossness, he becomes gross in this universe.
And by taking the deception of subtleness, he becomes subtle.
So, he exists or he is situated in gross world and subtle world.
He alone is the player in gross world and subtle world.
Pratibhya Amapi, in Pratibhya also it is said.
It is because of his independence, independent freedom.
Independent means satan there, freedom of consciousness.
He creates this whole universe just direct from his own nature.
So, his nature becomes, his reality of being becomes universe.
He is not separate from his being.
This whole universe is not separate from his being.
So, objective world is made of subjective consciousness.
Subjective consciousness has created this objective world.
Pratibhya Amapi, this objective world is not created by the power of this objectivity of its own nature.
This objective world is created because of subjective consciousness.
So, subjective consciousness is the player, is the creator of everything, whatever is created.
In the objective field or subjective field.
Agamapi, in tantra also it is said.
Jalam Himam Juyo Veda, Guru Vaktar Agamahat Priya, Naseva Taisikarta Vyam Taseya Pashchamijan Matav.
Oh dear, Priya, oh dear Parvati, the one who understands what reality lies in water
and it is calculated formation snow.
This substance is the same, but the formation is separate.
Snow and water is water.
There is difference between water and snow.
But the substance of these two are one, is one.
The one who realizes, the one who realizes by the grace of master, Guru Vaktar Agamahat,
the difference between water and snow.
Naseva Taisikarta Vyam, for Him nothing remains undone.
Naseva Taisikarta Vyam, for Him nothing remains undone in this world.
Taseya Pashchamijan Matav, hence this is his last birth in this universe.
He won't come again in the repeated wheel of birth and death.
He is Jivan Mukta, then.
Anineva Aashena Uhtam, holding this way of explanation within,
Spanda also declares in the same way, in this Shloka.
Yetiva Aashya Samviti, Kri Dha Teena Khelam Jagat, Pashya Sattam Yukto, Jivan Mukto Nasemshe,
the one who observes the difference between universe and its creator.
What is the difference between universe and its creator?
Nothing, creator has become universe and universe is the formation of creator.
For Him, this whole universe is a play.
It is nothing wrong.
The one who realizes this surpassing Sattam Yukta,
he is always attached to his own reality of self-consciousness.
Jivan Mukta, he is Jivan Mukta, he is liberated in this very life Nasemshe,
there is no doubt about it.
